data: Amazon was the larger company by revenue in fiscal 2025. It reported net sales of about $716.9 billion for fiscal 2025, which ended December 31, 2025, up roughly 11% from $638.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Apple reported revenue of $416.2 billion for fiscal 2025, which ended September 27, 2025, up about 6% from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Amazon's revenue was therefore about 1.72 times Apple's, a gap of roughly $300 billion. The two fiscal years do not line up exactly, since Apple's ends in late September and Amazon's follows the calendar year. These figures are from memory of the companies' annual results, so check them against the 10-K filings before relying on them.
